result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but one section header displays a raw localization key instead of translated text, which is the most obvious visual break. There is also a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between cards.

issues.description: The section heading above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card renders the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g., 'Popular near you'). This looks broken and unprofessional to users.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the key 'home_feed.popular_title' in the localization files and ensure a sensible fallback title is displayed if a key is missing.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on the ramen card has no dark circular background, unlike the pizza card below where the heart sits on a dark circle. On the lighter ramen image the white outline heart has weak contrast and the treatment is inconsistent across cards.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular backdrop to the heart button on all restaurant cards for consistent styling and adequate contrast against any image.
